title: Sewers, Hand
description: Sew, join, reinforce, or finish, usually with needle and thread, a variety of manufactured items. Includes weavers and stitchers.

tasks.text: Select thread, twine, cord, or yarn to be used, and thread needles.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

tasks.text: Measure and align parts, fasteners, or trimmings, following seams, edges, or markings on parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Trim excess threads or edges of parts, using scissors or knives.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

tasks.text: Sew, join, reinforce, or finish parts of articles, such as garments, books, mattresses, toys, and wigs, using needles and thread or other materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sewing clothing requires fine manual dexterity

tasks.text: Use different sewing techniques such as felling, tacking, basting, embroidery, and fagoting.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sewing clothing requires fine manual dexterity

tasks.text: Fit garments on clients, altering as needed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Measure clients to ensure proper product fit.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.

tasks.text: Smooth seams with heated irons, flat bones, or rubbing sticks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand sanding and finishing of physical objects

dwas.name: Smooth surfaces of objects or equipment.

tasks.text: Draw and cut patterns according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Generates template designs; aesthetic fit needs human review

dwas.name: Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

tasks.text: Fold, twist, stretch, or drape material, and secure articles in preparation for sewing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Adjusting fabric is tactile manual work

dwas.name: Adjust fabrics or other materials during garment production.

tasks.text: Sew buttonholes, or add lace or other trimming.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sewing clothing requires fine manual dexterity

tasks.text: Tie, knit, weave or knot ribbon, yarn, or decorative materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sewing and assembling textiles needs fine dexterity

emerging_tasks.task: Patch materials, such as cotton or leather.
